items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: Well maybe Sinatra and Nelson Riddle or something like that era where there was a great arranger and a full orchestra and I could just not worry about anything but singing the song.

ctx.x: I just mean like is there a record date or something that you’d like to have watched or something like that?

Well maybe Sinatra and Nelson Riddle or something like that era where there was a great arranger and a full orchestra and I could just not worry about anything but singing the song. You know, maybe that era, right.
Yeah. That must have been a heck of a feeling when you did that with the Metropole Orchestra. Did you do that live?
